recurrence: X0=existing RAW; Xr=project_original_C(official_denoise(Xr-1)); reuse frozen X1; no GEO between rounds; one independent fixed GEO_C at each evaluated endpoint
precision: BF16 network autocast; FP32 weights, residual addition, scaling and output; SDPA math; TF32 off; strict deterministic

postprocess_config.anchor_rule: one distinct numeric C coordinate within radius; conflicting coordinates leave free corner fixed
postprocess_config.degenerate_rule: free only: exact repeated coordinate or exactly zero FP64 cross product
postprocess_config.duplicate_rule: free only: same three numeric coordinates ignoring winding; C wins, then first retained free source face
postprocess_config.free_rule: lexicographic original-point representatives; nearest existing representative within radius; no transitive unions or means
postprocess_config.known_vertex_identity: FP32 coordinate bytes, including signed zero
postprocess_config.normalization: NONE; never normalize the generated bbox
postprocess_config.radius_limit: Single engineering threshold; original paper runtime units are not fully traceable

metrics: Same eight strict F-only A-VMR/PMR settings, frozen C2048 quality queries, actual POST free denominators and indexed topology
scope: Current USER_MIX only; six previously inspected DEV parents and two fixed noises; no other generator checkpoints
failure_policy: Stop on nonfinite/OOM; completed per-round receipts reusable; no silent replay of a started forward lacking receipt; no >48 attempts
stopping: Complete fixed D3/D5 plus baseline comparison and stop; no training/distillation/default switch/commit/push
